scope: descriptive audit of the already registered single apt_1 camera-only 30 ms pilot; not a training acceptance or generator ranking rule

flow.label: 10 ms endpoint displacement from the saved renderer z-depth, pixel-index K, and captured camera poses
flow.valid: compute_se3_flow validity AND projected endpoint inside [0,W) x [0,H)
flow.motion_mask: flow magnitude > 1.0 pixel per 10 ms interval

texture.image: scene-linear float32 radiance luma Y=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B at each interval's first endpoint
texture.texture_mask: gradient magnitude > 0.005 radiance units per pixel

events.pixel_support: round event x/y to nearest integer pixel; active if at least one event in the interval
events.common_mask: union of normal EventGenesis and pinned V2E active-pixel support for the same interval
events.window_rule: left-open, right-closed event timestamp intervals; EG seconds and V2E microseconds converted to seconds

reported_coverages: texture AND GT-motion area within valid frame
per-generator active pixels and shared union active pixels
shared union coverage over valid, GT-motion, and texture AND GT-motion areas
selection_or_tuning: No sample, scene, camera pose, threshold, generator setting, model, or checkpoint is selected using these counts or metrics.
